reasons: Cited text supports the compliant status: § 8.2 provides automatic successive twelve-month (not multi-year) renewal terms with a 30-day Customer non-renewal notice window, well inside the preferred ≤30-day parameter and far below the 90-day walk-away threshold.
§ 8.2 also includes the preferred 60-day Vendor renewal reminder, plus a pro-Customer extension of the opt-out deadline if the reminder is late, so the window cannot be lost through Vendor inaction.
§ 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent with 90 days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods, matching the preferred cap exactly.

The single failing deterministic check ('number not found') is credibly explained as a parser false negative because all figures are drafted in word form ('thirty days'', 'twelve-month', 'three percent'); the rationale maps each to its numeric value.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment is proposed and the paragraphs are returned unchanged; § 8.1's three-year figure is a fixed initial term rather than an automatic multi-year renewal.
